title: Glowing bus
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Shadow glow beneath bus -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="38" ry="6" fill="#1a3a5c" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Bus body -->
  <rect x="12" y="30" width="76" height="42" rx="7" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <!-- Body sunlight highlight top -->
  <rect x="15" y="33" width="70" height="7" rx="4" fill="#ffe680"/>
  <!-- Lower body stripe -->
  <rect x="12" y="58" width="76" height="14" rx="6" fill="#e6a800"/>
  <!-- Windows -->
  <rect x="18" y="38" width="14" height="13" rx="2.5" fill="#3ec1ff"/>
  <rect x="36" y="38" width="14" height="13" rx="2.5" fill="#3ec1ff"/>
  <rect x="54" y="38" width="14" height="13" rx="2.5" fill="#3ec1ff"/>
  <rect x="72" y="38" width="11" height="13" rx="2.5" fill="#3ec1ff"/>
  <!-- Window highlights -->
  <rect x="19.5" y="39.5" width="5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#c8f0ff"/>
  <rect x="37.5" y="39.5" width="5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#c8f0ff"/>
  <rect x="55.5" y="39.5" width="5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#c8f0ff"/>
  <!-- Door -->
  <rect x="18" y="53" width="12" height="17" rx="2" fill="#b88900"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="54" x2="24" y2="69" stroke="#ffcc33" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="64" r="4" fill="#fff7b0"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="64" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Front bumper light -->
  <rect x="84" y="56" width="5" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#ff8844"/>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="74" r="8" fill="#2a2a3a"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="74" r="3.5" fill="#8a8aa0"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="74" r="8" fill="#2a2a3a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="74" r="3.5" fill="#8a8aa0"/>
  <!-- Wheel arches -->
  <path d="M18 72 a10 10 0 0 1 20 0" fill="none" stroke="#e6a800" stroke-width="3"/>
  <path d="M60 72 a10 10 0 0 1 20 0" fill="none" stroke="#e6a800" stroke-width="3"/>
</svg>
